title: Exploring the potential molecular mechanism of Gualou Guizhi decoction in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis based on network pharmacology and molecular docking.
authors: Duan, Zhihao; Jin, Can; Ma, Shuai; Liu, Jinlang; Li, Shigang; Zhou, You
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究瓜蒌桂枝汤治疗类风湿关节炎的机制，虽涉及分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) has been used in China for a long time and is gradually gaining more and more recognition worldwide. Gualou Guizhi Decoction (GGD) has long been used as a folk medicine for the treatment of rheumatic diseases, but its bioactive components and therapeutic mechanisms are still unclear. METHODS: An integrated approach using network pharmacology and molecular docking and using methotrexate as a positive control drug. RESULTS: We obtained 157 active ingredients of GGD, 7542 RA disease targets and 49 intersecting targets. GO and KEGG enrichment analysis revealed that their functions were mainly related to cytokine active metal ion binding, enzyme binding and DNA binding, and enriched in TNF signaling pathway, T cell receptor signaling pathway, Toll-like receptor signaling pathway, RA pathway and other signaling pathways that are closely related to RA. The molecular docking results show that the effector components of GGD bind better to the core targets of RA, and some are even better than methotrexate. CONCLUSION: The therapeutic effect of GGD for RA is achieved by affecting the core targets such as VEGFA, IL-1beta, IL6, CXCL8, CCL2, and JUN, which together interfere with the tumor necrosis factor signaling pathway and RA pathway to treat RA. The above study provides new ideas for further exploration of this classic formula in the future.
abstract_zh: 背景：中医药（TCM）在中国有着悠久的使用历史，并逐渐在全球范围内获得越来越多的认可。瓜蒌桂枝汤（GGD）长期以来被用作治疗风湿性疾病的民间药物，但其生物活性成分和治疗机制仍不清楚。方法：采用网络药理学与分子对接相结合的综合方法，并以甲氨蝶呤作为阳性对照药物。结果：我们获得了GGD的157种活性成分、7542个类风湿关节炎（RA）疾病靶点以及49个交集靶点。GO和KEGG富集分析显示，其功能主要与细胞因子活性金属离子结合、酶结合和DNA结合相关，并富集于TNF信号通路、T细胞受体信号通路、Toll样受体信号通路、RA通路等与RA密切相关的信号通路。分子对接结果表明，GGD的效应成分与RA核心靶点的结合较好，部分甚至优于甲氨蝶呤。结论：GGD对RA的治疗作用是通过影响VEGFA、IL-1β、IL6、CXCL8、CCL2和JUN等核心靶点实现的，这些靶点共同干扰肿瘤坏死因子信号通路和RA通路以治疗RA。上述研究为未来进一步探索这一经典方剂提供了新思路。
